name: avatar-picker
title: Avatar Picker
description: A person's avatar that opens a dialog to upload, change or remove their photo — the file is staged in a 128px drop circle and saved only on Update.

meta.whenToUse: A profile or member settings row where someone sets their own photo.
meta.whenNotToUse: Attaching files to a record (Dropzone / Attachment) or picking a person (SearchableSelect).
